name: dogfood-mcp-tool-agent
description: Dogfood app (v1.15-5) — a Node.js MCP tool-use agent that exposes 3 tools (weather / calculator / search) via a Model Context Protocol server and drives an Anthropic Claude client through the JSON-RPC 2.0 initialize -> tools/list -> tools/call chain, drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (spawns @modelcontextprotocol/sdk stdio server + optional real Anthropic Messages API when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa-test/mcp in-process McpServer + @kiwa-test/ai-llm createAnthropicMock) so behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa-test/quality-metrics 11-axis release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-test/ai-llm -F @kiwa-test/core -F @kiwa-test/mcp -F @kiwa-test/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
